reasons.text: Independent tests (Stiftung Warentest 3.6, ComputerBild 3.3) criticize high ink costs and small paper tray.

Ink cartridges cost about 126 EUR/year, making total cost of ownership high despite 49 EUR price.
Only 4 offers and 10 reviews for the near-identical 2820e; thin market presence and low sample.
